title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.09 (versions follow prime numbers; 509 after 503): a book of the disk is not read as lines. In her house such a book holds the address of a file, not text; three of her readers opened it as lines and the address, with the bytes before it, came out in her answers. One rule now for every reader of a book as lines. Seen in a hidden copy with her real ways: eight answers with no byte that is not text. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.09: un libro del disco no se lee como renglones. Prototipo de investigación.
